fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2026-04-22, a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 96,000 was withdrawn. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2026-04-22 at roughly 18:15. Contact details given by the complainant, Saranya Murugan, include the number 9000000193. A person named Prakash Muthu, associated with the number 9000000312, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Ganesh Shankar (9000000155), described as a neighbour, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant mentioned a call detail reference and social media screenshots.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Social media screenshot
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, evening, screenshot, call detail, suspect, main street, associate
